cases.historical_identity: TRUEE and DTAC predecessor securities; new True Corporation security TRUE
cases.transition: Amalgamation registered 2023-03-01; SET50 change effective 2023-03-02; TRUE traded 2023-03-03
cases.price_treatment: Keep TRUEE, DTAC, and TRUE OHLCV separate; no synthetic splice; any economic-return bridge requires approved corporate-action policy
cases.membership_treatment: Use TRUEE/DTAC before the effective boundary and TRUE after it; do not backfill the new TRUE into earlier snapshots
cases.bias_risk: Survivorship and lookahead if new TRUE is used in pre-2023 membership

cases.historical_identity: GULF Energy, INTUCH, temporary GULFI, then GULF Development
cases.transition: Suspension 2025-03-21 to 2025-04-02; post-amalgamation GULF inclusion effective 2025-04-02
cases.price_treatment: Keep pre-event GULF, INTUCH/GULFI, and post-event GULF boundary-separated; preserve suspension; no synthetic splice
cases.membership_treatment: Apply historical member symbol in each effective snapshot; post-event GULF is not evidence of prior INTUCH membership
cases.bias_risk: Lookahead and fabricated continuity around merger and suspension

cases.historical_identity: Ngern Tid Lor (NTL) predecessor and TIDLOR Holdings replacement under ticker TIDLOR
cases.transition: TIDLOR listed/traded in place of NTL effective 2025-05-15
cases.price_treatment: Keep NTL and TIDLOR raw series separate; a 1:1 share-swap bridge is not permission to join OHLCV
cases.membership_treatment: Use NTL before 2025-05-15 and TIDLOR after the effective boundary
cases.bias_risk: Survivorship and false performance continuity if the current TIDLOR file is backfilled

cases.historical_identity: Banpu security temporarily renamed BANPUU during BANPU/BPP amalgamation, then BANPU relisted
cases.transition: BANPUU effective during 2026-07-17 suspension; BANPUU/BPP delisted 2026-07-31; BANPU traded 2026-08-04 onward
cases.price_treatment: Keep BANPU, BANPUU, and post-event BANPU separate at raw-data level; corporate-action adjustment requires explicit policy
cases.membership_treatment: Use the exact symbol published in each effective SET50 snapshot; do not infer BANPUU membership from a change notice
cases.bias_risk: Lookahead if post-amalgamation BANPU is used before its effective listing

cases.historical_identity: MR. D.I.Y. Holding (Thailand) Public Company Limited
cases.price_treatment: Use only from listing/trading date; no pre-listing price history
cases.membership_treatment: Membership can begin only in snapshots effective after listing
cases.bias_risk: Lookahead/survivorship if pre-listing observations are fabricated

cases.historical_identity: SCB X (SCB) holding company replaced SCBB (The Siam Commercial Bank)
cases.transition: SCB listed and SCBB delisted 2022-04-27 through restructuring/share swap
cases.price_treatment: Keep SCBB and SCB raw series separate; SET used the last SCBB price for limits, which is not proof of OHLCV continuity
cases.membership_treatment: Use SCBB before and SCB after the effective boundary unless official snapshot states otherwise
cases.bias_risk: False continuity and lookahead if holding-company history is treated as bank history

cases.historical_identity: TMB Bank renamed TMBThanachart Bank; ticker TMB changed to TTB
cases.price_treatment: A date-effective ticker mapping is plausible; do not adjust OHLCV unless separate corporate-action evidence requires it
cases.membership_treatment: Map TMB before 2021-05-12 and TTB after; preserve the historical published symbol
cases.bias_risk: Missing or duplicated observations at the ticker boundary
